sloka: अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमुत्पपात निशाचरः।उत्पत्य च हमूमन्तं ताडयामास मुष्टिना ।। ६.७०.४५ ।।
transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇastaṁ ghoṣamutpapāta niśācaraḥ।utpatya ca hamūmantaṁ tāḍayāmāsa muṣṭinā ।। 6.70.45 ।।

translations.english: Unable to bear that roar, that Rakshasa got up jumping and struck Hanuman with his fist.
